title: French interactive verb explorer
summary: Made verbs in Sai-specific French extension sentences interactive so a learner can tap a conjugated verb or infinitive to see its English meaning, dictionary infinitive, present-tense forms, usage note and hear each form.

areas.title: Verb understanding
areas.summary: Tap verbs in personal extension sentences to inspect meaning and infinitive

areas.title: Conjugation
areas.summary: Show all six present-tense subject forms for aimer adorer faire jouer and nager

areas.title: Pronunciation
areas.summary: Add audio controls for each conjugated verb form

areas.title: Personal French
areas.summary: Connect grammar exploration directly to sailing hockey netball orchestra and swimming examples

data.notes: Current app data is local-only. Firebase architecture is documented but not connected. Historical snapshots do not imply historical learner data.
